title: Cloud authorization target — Cedar as the universal gate for the Oyatie Cloud control plane + cloud-* resources
purpose: Target spec for how Cedar (ADR-0243) authorizes every Cloud Control Plane request and cloud-* resource operation. Conforms to specs/cedar-policy-schema.json + cedar-fragment-schema.json (does not redefine them). Honest non-claim: target/binding spec only; no Cedar runtime, policy evaluation, or enforcement is implemented here.
enforcement_points: Cloud Control Plane API Gateway (every CRUD/query request — default-deny, ADR-0243)
per-resource operation gate (create/update/delete on each cloud-* resource type)
cross-tenant + cross-cell boundary checks (ADR-0244 tenant scope; ADR-0248 cell isolation)

entity_action_model.principals: Cloud IAM identities + workload identities scoped to organization/account/project (ADR-0244)
entity_action_model.resources: ORN-addressed resources in the resource model (Org->Account->Project->Region->Cell->ResourceGroup->Resource)
entity_action_model.context: region, cell, deployment-model (shared|dedicated), compliance pack, autonomy tier

default_posture: default-deny; permit sets are explicit; fail-closed on policy evaluation error (no fail-open).

compliance_overlays.model: per-pack Cedar fragments (ADR-0251 pack overlays) for KR + JP + US + EU; jurisdiction + data-residency + cross-border-transfer constraints expressed as Cedar conditions

fragment_lifecycle: authored as Cedar fragments with fixtures; soak + anomaly rollback per ADR-0294; promotion gated; audit mapping per ADR-0263.
non_claims: Target/binding spec only — references the canonical Cedar schemas; does not implement Cedar policy evaluation, the control-plane gate runtime, fragments, fixtures, or enforcement.
No production/security-maturity claim; tenant-isolation + default-deny enforcement claims stay blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green.
